pages.title: Contact Matters
pages.text: A crystal produced by the first purification seems able to exchange energy only with a machine touching it directly. If it is placed on the wrong face, no energy flows even when the link itself is valid.$(br2)Sneak-use it empty-handed to switch direction: $(bold)Input$() draws energy from the adjacent equipment, while $(bold)Output$() sends energy into it.

pages.title: Resonance Limits
pages.text: The distance, number of links, and rate of energy flow a crystal can sustain all vary with the properties of its material.$(br2)So far, Draconium and Wyvern crystals have supported 2 and 3 crystal links at distances of 32 and 64 blocks.
